name: Pop Art
traits: flat saturated blocks of primary and fluorescent colour
enlarged halftone dots and line screens instead of shading
suits: packaged consumer goods with a strong shape and colour (drinks, snacks, cosmetics); loud, confident, fun brands
stylePara: Pop-art print look: flat saturated blocks of primary and fluorescent colour, red, yellow, cyan and hot pink, divided by thick black outlines; shading made only of enlarged halftone dots in one or two sizes and diagonal line screens, never smooth gradients; slightly off-register silkscreen layers, so colour slips a little past the line; flat graphic backgrounds of solid colour or repeating dots and stripes; faces simplified to a few bold shapes with glossy high-contrast lips and eyes; objects presented as bold isolated icons; the product is celebrated like an icon.

rendering.line: thick uniform black outlines, simplified contours
rendering.shading: halftone dots and diagonal line screens in flat tones; no gradients
rendering.colour: primary and fluorescent flat colours with hard contrasts, deliberate off-register; product colours exact as the anchor
rendering.texture: silkscreen ink and printed dot screens on smooth paper
rendering.lighting: no naturalistic lighting: light is expressed as a flat lighter block or a dot screen

motion: Graphic and rhythmic: snaps on the beat, short held poses on fours with sudden jumps, colour-swap loops where the same frame repeats in new palettes; very few in-betweens; the dot screen stays fixed and does not swim with the movement.
camera: Flat frontal compositions and centred close-ups; static frames and graphic zoom-punches; repetition grids are built in the edit.
avoid: halftone dots swimming or scaling during motion
soft gradient shading replacing dot screens
word bursts and onomatopoeia with fake text
real packaging logos in a repeated grid
sheets: Characters as a bold front and three-quarter portrait in the print style plus a flat colour-swatch strip; the product as a centred icon on a solid colour with its exact shape and colours; one palette-variant version of the product to test repetition grids.
risk: Halftone texture is a screen pattern that Seedance redraws every frame, so dots crawl and buzz; keep motion small, clips 3-5 s, and write 'the dot screen is fixed and does not move'. It also adds word bursts; ban them in NO TEXT. Build repeated grids and colour swaps in the edit from one good clip.

example.prompt: Pop-art print still: a woman in her thirties with a dark bun and an orange top, simplified to bold shapes with thick black outlines and glossy high-contrast lips, holds a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap up like an icon, in a sunny kitchen of flat yellow and cyan blocks; a droopy fern on the windowsill is shaded with enlarged halftone dots; red diagonal line screens in the shadows, slightly off-register silkscreen colour, solid hot-pink wall. Vertical 9:16. No text.
